IMU motion-noise gate: paired validation

Configured accelerometer white noise is propagated through the exact integration and quadratic-removal operators. The additional quality check requires reliable full-3D excitation above a conservative noise bound. Likelihood fits and the zero gamma threshold are unchanged.

The same carrier observations and IMU realization are used for each before/after pair. Both carrier cases share their IMU. Only the IMU noise seed varies; carrier noise and motion are fixed. Attitude remains supplied. This is conditional synthetic validation, not a field detection probability.

Ungated: 1984 windows, 42 false alarms, 9 missed detections, 790 inconclusive. Gated: 1984 windows, 0 false alarms, 0 missed detections, 1320 inconclusive.

Settings and assumptions · Summary JSON · Summary CSV · Paired windows and noise checks · All figures as PDF

Coverage and errors

Zero-noise reference evaluated once; other levels use the listed seeds. Inconclusive is a separate outcome. Rejecting uncertain movement can reduce coverage, including rotation-only motion at higher noise.

The bound covers independent isotropic Gaussian accelerometer noise conditional on supplied attitude and timestamps. Bias, attitude uncertainty, clock error, numerical integration error and coloured sensor noise are excluded. The tail bound is per window and is not a spoofing false-alarm rate.
